final: WITH per_station AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n FROM per_station), shares AS (SELECT p.observstation, p.n, 1.0 * p.n / NULLIF(t.total_n, 0) AS share FROM per_station p CROSS JOIN total t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.n, s.share, s.share - a.mean_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.mean_share) SELECT AVG(n), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM kept
